title: 镜像对舞 / Mirrored duet
author: Rhythm Master
license_status: First-party composition using existing attributed operators; outbound license pending

descriptions.en-US: Arrange your image as two counter-rotating mirrored panels. Bass opens the spacing and highs draw the panels inward; resize each side and tune their overlap.
descriptions.zh-CN: 将输入图像排成反向转动的双路镜像。低频拉开间距、高频聚拢画面，两侧缩放及叠合强度均可编辑。
